key_evidence_spans: A patient in their early 60s presented with a 2-week history of chest pain during exertion
The chest pain consistently presented during physical activity
The baseline 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) showed no substantial abnormalities
Patient developed left bundle-branch block (LBBB) in stage 2 at heart rate of 107 beats per minute with chest pain
LBBB resolved following exercise cessation with immediate angina relief
No ischemic or memory T waves in pre- and post-exercise ECGs
Coronary computed tomography angiography showed no abnormalities
